user.title: Set up Ghost Mode
user.description: Ghost Mode learns how your home looks while it is occupied and replays that pattern while you are away, so an empty house still looks lived-in. Submit to add it — it finds your lights, switches, covers and media players on its own.

abort.already_configured: Ghost Mode is already set up.

init.title: Ghost Mode options
init.description: Ghost Mode finds its own entities. Use this only to drop ones it should ignore — duplicates of the same hardware, or device settings that are permanently on and that nobody outside can see.

data_description.paste: One per line or comma separated. They are added to the list above, so you do not have to click each one.

learn_now.name: Learn now
learn_now.description: Read recorder history into the learned profile straight away, instead of waiting for the nightly run.

forget.name: Forget everything
forget.description: Throw the learned profile away and rebuild it from whatever recorder history still exists. Use after an update changes how the profile is measured.
